the artist as truth / who can be an artist?
i think to to know what beauty is, is to be able to see the truth, as the world is immensely beautiful, despite (because?) suffering. therefore, to be an artist, is to be able to see the truth. this seems like it would be an easy criteria, but it's actually harder than i would like. most people cannot see the truth of themselves, how could they possibly see the truth of the world? oscar wilde, the critic as artist: It is tragic how few people ever 'possess their souls' before they die.

first bloom
Oscar Wilde said, "A work of art is useless as a flower is useless. A flower blossoms for its own joy. We gain a moment of joy looking at it." First Bloom brings together two talented designers who have created garments with a floral motif, worn by dancers en pointe. A celebration of the finite—perhaps the purest form of art? What has more truth than something that blooms knowing it will quickly perish?
